purpose: needs-analysis primary research on digital and AI skills among adults and employers in three Romanian NUTS-2 regions
design_assumptions_required_for_this_scr: controller identity remains unresolved until documented and approved from actual purpose/essential-means authority
no direct identifiers in analytical forms
no free-text fields in analytical forms; respondent input is restricted to controlled categories, booleans, ratings and matrices
no employee monitoring or systematic tracking
no advertising, fingerprinting, cross-site tracking or CRM linkage
no automated decision about a respondent and no legal or similarly significant effect
no raw IP address or user-agent in analytical records or NF06 exports
raw respondent-level records are not sent to third-party generative-AI/LLM services; any AI-assisted analysis operates only on sufficiently de-identified/aggregated material
small reported cells are suppressed/combined when n < 5

edpb_high_risk_criteria_screen.large_scale_personal_data_processing: NOT_EXPECTED; re-screen if sample volume/scope materially expands
edpb_high_risk_criteria_screen.vulnerable_data_subjects: POSSIBLE_CONTEXTUAL_ONLY; unemployed adults may warrant added care but the form does not make decisions about them

mandatory_re_screen_triggers: raw respondent records or profiles are sent to an external AI/LLM provider
direct identifiers or stable respondent tracking are introduced
respondent data are matched to CRM, employment, public-register or other datasets
individual scoring/profiling is used for eligibility, recruitment, training access or other decisions
sample scale or monitoring changes enough to plausibly qualify as large-scale/high-risk processing
hosting/logging architecture makes analytical records routinely linkable to IP/device identity
note: This is an engineering/compliance screening record, not external legal advice. If any design assumption is false, the screening fails closed and must be repeated before collection.
